subject: general
question: Anshuman and Kunal together invested ₹70,400 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹12,000, Kunal's share was ₹1,800. What was the difference between their investments?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total profit = 12,000 and **Kunal's share** = 1,800.

**Anshuman's share** = 12,000 − 1,800 = 10,200.

Profit ratio (Anshuman : Kunal) = 10,200 : 1,800 = **17 : 3**.

Investment ratio = Profit ratio = 17 : 3 (since time is constant).

Total ratio parts = 17 + 3 = 20. Difference in parts = 17 − 3 = 14.

Difference = (70,400 ÷ 20) × 14 = 3,520 × 14 = **49,280**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹49,280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Total Investment = 70,400 | Total Profit = 12,000 | Kunal's Profit = 1,800.
Formulas: Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio | Share = (Total Value ÷ Total Ratio) × Specific Ratio.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/975212003f02f9ba97ab7f4bdbcc3a1af32027ad90de9ae745594830bef3c40e.png] 
⇒ Anshuman's Profit = 12,000 − 1,800 = 10,200.
⇒ Profit Ratio (A:K) = 10,200/1,800 = 102/18 = 17/3.
⇒ Let Anshuman's investment be 17x and Kunal's be 3x.
⇒ 17x + 3x = 70,400 ⇒ 20x = 70,400 ⇒ x = 3,520.
⇒ Difference = 17x − 3x = 14x = 14 × 3,520 = 49,280.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹49,280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Principle

When the time period of investment is the same for all partners, the **profit is distributed** in the direct ratio of their **investments**.

Compound Partnership

If time periods are different, Profit Ratio = (Capital₁ × Time₁) : (Capital₂ × Time₂).
